barRaise.topFinding: No code moved since the 2026-07-25 pass: HEAD is still 77efb38 / 0.58.3 with zero commits, so the money-path finding set is unchanged and unrepaired and was re-verified present in current source rather than assumed. security-01 (any signed-in user can PATCH their own profiles row and self-grant Pro or superadmin), compliance-03 (account deletion never cancels the Stripe subscription) and auth-01 (billing identity from an unverified body.userId, now open 21 runs) all still read exactly as they did yesterday. What moved is the publish path, and it moved the wrong way by standing still: the dashboard version has been stuck at 0.57.0 for two days across roughly five scheduled passes over the same file while canonical is 0.58.3, and the Discord release notification has not landed for four releases going back to 2026-07-07. Today's canonical audit then found the one public document nobody was sweeping: README.md is 24 releases stale, lists three shipped features as designed-but-not-built, and never mentions that the app has taken real money since 0.54.0. That is the third instance this week of the same class of problem, which is that YaC's outward-facing surfaces are updated by unchecked best-effort steps while its code gates are strict.

Add the `ai-spend:` guard-and-accrue block to `handleExtractPhotosReal` and `handleParseCourseText`, cap `photos[]`, and charge one slot per photo.
Make `persist()` return a boolean or rethrow so a failed localStorage write stops being reported as "Saved.".
Route the consensus write at `courses.js:394` through `sanitizeCourse()`, allowlist the `path`, and cap `_consensusUpdates`.
Stamp a `_rev` on canonical course records and reject stale-rev writes, and correct the ADR 0010 atomicity claim.

Add a post-release assertion on `.discord_last_posted.txt` versus BUILD_VERSION, and re-run the notify for 0.58.0 through 0.58.3.
Persist the shared-round id to localStorage and call `loadActiveSharedRound()` at boot.
Route shared-round score writes through the outbox and make the poll merge rather than replace.
Persist starred slugs and canonical records for starred and recent courses so a cold offline launch can reach a real course.
Vendor `@supabase/supabase-js` at an exact version into the bundle, or pin, hash, precache and bound the retry.
Add a behaviour test for `src/subscription.ts` flag gating, wire it as a preship gate, and add an `npm test` script.
Write `docs/RUNBOOK-billing.md` covering double charge, refund, webhook outage, stuck entitlement and Supabase outage.
Shard the by-name course index, memoize the parsed index, add Cache-Control to library and lookup, and stop rewriting it from the public nearby path.
Replace the hard-coded `limit=5000` map pull with a viewport or GPS-scoped query.
Delete the duplicate bar-raise, project-canonical-audit and handler-audit copies from the anthropic-skills plugin and qualify the names in both scheduled-task files.
Add a Wave 5 step reading `.work-queue-archive.json` so completed findings close automatically.
Rewrite `legal/COUNSEL_BRIEFING.md` around the live freemium model and add billing rows to both counsel checklists.
Re-derive `MONTHLY_CADDY_RECS_PER_USER` from the shipped $1/mo price and update the CONTEXT.md cost-cap math.
Feed the worker's money-path catch blocks into the `error:buffer:v1` rolling buffer with kind=server.
Add the three legal/ prose files to preship gate `[11]` and the release.ps1 `$canonDocs` array.
Add a CI job running the preship gauntlet as a `needs` dependency of the Pages deploy, and drop the `-SkipPreship` recommendation.
Make wrangler deploy failure abort before the Discord post, and trigger on the live worker's appVersion rather than the pre-commit tree.
Replace the inline onclick interpolation at `src/shared-rounds-ui.ts:187` with a dataset-bound listener, and stop persisting the admin token in localStorage.
Await the claim delete in the webhook's `fail()` path and defer the test's mock delete so a missing await fails the gate.
Add `[observability] enabled = true` to `worker/wrangler.toml` and redeploy.
Repackage project-canonical-audit from source with a read-back length check, confirming `## Output destination` and Phase 4.5 survive.

Port the corrected changelog-title pattern into `push-to-github.ps1:73` and fail loudly instead of "code update".
Split the CLAUDE.md:56 flag claim and drop the version pin from the `:59` heading.
Add an `AbortSignal.timeout` to `callApi` and the caddy and chat fetches.
Retire `@ts-nocheck` starting with `src/course-map.ts`, and record the tsconfig laxity as an ADR.
Wire the age attestation into `src/auth-modal.ts` or reword privacy Section 8.
Allowlist `returnUrl` against `getAllowedOrigins` and add a rate limit and body cap to the billing routes.
Collapse the two admin-token localStorage keys onto one, document it, and fix the misleading toast.
Delete the stale duplicate `worker/src/prompts/caddyRecommend.js` and its obsolete banner.

Filter the map marker loop by viewport bounds and lazy-build popup HTML.

Generate 64px and 128px WebP basket-logo variants and point the icon builder and precache at those.

Document the Worker deploy rollback in `scripts/README.md`.

Reconcile version and lastReleaseAt in the daily dashboard sync and exit non-zero on disagreement.
Rewrite the two stale YaC completion-gate queue items down to their actual remainder.
Mint a stable finding id per canonical-audit finding and require `prompt` and `finding_id` on every enqueued item.
Point drift-auto-fix and project-canonical-audit at `queue-edit.ps1 -Op add` instead of their own write mechanics.
Restore the Phase 8 enqueue and the `## Auto-enqueued: N` receipt in project-canonical-audit.
Restore Phase 8 into the personal-skills audit copy or strike its queue-these claim.
Uninstall the stale personal-skills handler-audit copy.
Add a post-deploy verification that the live site and `/api/config` report the released BUILD_VERSION before posting to Discord.
Sweep prose em dashes out of user-visible strings starting with the paywall modal.
Fix the "Chains AI" 402 message, the two "Yes and Chains" Settings strings, and the mismatched share/copy strings.
Reconcile the legal-entity name across `legal/terms.md`, `legal/privacy.md` and `src/legal-view.ts` before counsel.
Point README.md and `tools/repo_metadata.json` at yesandchains.com and re-run the metadata updater.
Extend the AI-tool-name pattern with model-family names and stamp a `patterns_verified` date.
Stop shipping `app.js.map` to Pages, or bring it inside `public_artifact_globs`.
Add paywall_shown, checkout_started and subscription_activated analytics with emitters in `src/subscription.ts`.
Fold the shared scores into the live active round instead of synthesizing a parallel record.
Call `cloudSyncRoundHistory()` at the end of `cloudLoadAll`.
Wrap the four `Sync-*Version` WriteAllText calls in the proven write-verify-retry loop.
Break the four import cycles by moving cloud.ts's domain callbacks behind a registration seam.

Write `tools/kv_restore.py` and prove it once against a scratch namespace.

Add a contextual-filter exemption so AI vendor names in legal and subprocessor contexts are not flagged or auto-rewritten.
Make the webhook claim two-phase, short TTL on entry and 72h after the Supabase write lands.
Fix the `hazard_catalog` path in `.project-context.json` and the architecture template, and add Stripe hazards to the catalog.
Reverse the caddy counter key to day-first and batch its per-key gets.
Drop the rebuild-index default batch to ~150 and the cap to ~300.
Collapse the two keyboard-inset observers onto one variable and renumber the mobile-hooks headers.
Add a keyboard-shortcuts row to the Settings About block.
Backfill the 0.58.x money-path incidents into `docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md` and re-attach it to the release path.
Rewrite `.project-context.json`'s `scheduled_tasks` to the four real task ids and cadences.
Provision or remove the three declared-but-missing Discord webhooks and fix the post-audit-digests role mismatch.
Rewrite the em dashes in README.md and PROJECT_SPEC.md.
Add the missing `_bodyTooLarge` and make the deletion-scrub `maxBatch` cap ~150.
Make `_scrubMyKvAttribution` throw when the loop exits without `done`, and add an orphan-attribution sweep.
